claims.statement: The node grid is a fixed 4 columns x 3 rows = 12 slots (Grid::kColumns=4, kRows=3, kSlotCount=12 in NodeModel.h — the ticket's open question resolved at build time, not a UiPref); slot cells are 84x60 px with a 12 px gap, origin at (24, 44).

The slots form one snake signal path: slotOrigin mirrors the column for the middle row (row % 2 == 1) so the path runs top row left->right, middle row right->left, bottom row left->right — one contiguous input->output path, not three independent lanes.

The grid maps the left lane 1:1 in lane order (slot i = lane block i, blockAt returns &lane[slot] for ANY block kind); tail slots beyond the lane length are empty = a valid bypassed pass-through state, the key difference from the gallery where every tile is an effect. Right-lane-only blocks get an overflow note, not their own lane (out of scope).

Grid exposes slotAt(point) (point-in-cell) and slotNearest(point, radius) (nearest slot centre within a drop tolerance, so a dragged node lands where aimed, not only when the pointer is inside the cell); hit testing uses the item-centre convention (MIT port of the reference grid, 2026-10-17).

orderWith(blockId, targetSlot) splices the full left-lane id list (erase the block, insert at the clamped target position, keep every other block's relative order) and returns a valid single-lane permutation for ChainStore::reorderBlocks.

The per-kind table carries a local (non-theme) colour, a custom_icons glyph, and a short label: delay (62,207,142) kFxDelay "Delay", chorus (88,144,235) "Chorus", tremolo (116,160,245) "Trem", compressor (160,160,168) "Comp", reverb (64,224,208) "Rev", convolution (235,120,150) "IR", and tone/other (235,170,80) "Tone"; paletteKinds() offers the six effect kinds (tone blocks are not palette nodes).

NodeView (juce::Component + ChainStore::Listener, refreshes on every chain change) owns the inner classes NodeBlock (one grid slot), PaletteItem (a chip that is a drag source for a new effect), NodeStrip (the selected block's param row), DragHostOverlay (routes the pointer while a drag is in flight), Ghost, and the NodeDragManager struct.

Pointer grammar on a node (the reference grid's MIT port): a short click selects the block (params appear in the strip), a 250 ms hold (kLongPressMs) begins a drag, motion before the hold cancels, right-click opens the block menu (power toggle — help key nodePower — and remove, help key nodeRemove); drops land via Grid::slotNearest(centre, 36.0f) and commit through chain.reorderBlocks(model_.orderWith(id, slot)).

The param strip (kStripH=112 px, below the palette row) shows the selected block's name / mode / power / remove plus its knobs from the SHARED paramsFor table (hoisted to views/gallery/EffectParams.h from the gallery tile; tone nodes show only In/Out/Mix trims); every write goes through ChainStore, so the strip can never disagree with the gallery.

NodeViewToggle is a StereoModeToggle-style 80x36 two-segment gallery|node control (kViewTiles / kViewNodes icons, help key nodeViewToggle, setNodeView + onToggle callbacks) inserted LEFT of the preset bar in PluginHeader; the header seeds it from services_.prefs.getBool(UiPrefs::kNodeView, false) at construction.

The view choice persists as a plain UiPrefs key UiPrefs::kNodeView = "t3k.nodeView" (UiPrefs.h:68; stored as "true"/"false" strings, default false = gallery): PluginRoot::onNodeViewToggle writes prefs.setBool(kNodeView, nodeView) and calls main_.chainScreen().setView(nodeView).

ChainScreen grows a third view branch: setView(bool) hides the gallery and shows the node view (and back); the node view has NO DragScroller — ChainScreen::scroller() keeps returning gallery_.scroller() even while the node view is visible; closeDetail() restores whichever view nodeView_ says the user was in.
The node-view ticket added Help keys + entries: nodeViewToggle, nodeView, nodeEmptySlot, node, nodePower, nodeRemove, nodeMode.

The testbed node-main scenario (scenarios.json) inserts a populated chain (delay, chorus, insert, convolution, insert, reverb — all enabled at mix 0.5) and seeds "localStorage": {"t3k.nodeView": "true"} so the node view is the visible surface; --capture auto-iterates all scenarios, so node-main gets a golden with no Main.cpp change.

The node view is a second, TOGGLEABLE views layer over the same ChainState the gallery draws (ticket ui-block-interface-draft.md, user-specified 2026-10-17): no new DSP — a slot's contents ARE the existing ChainBlocks re-arranged in the ChainState lane order, and every mutation goes back through ChainStore so the gallery and node view can never disagree about the chain.
